verdict.rationale: Replit has a built-in 'Design' space that lets users explore/tweak visual designs and apply them to the app, and templates can be turned into functional sites by Agent while preserving visual design — this covers the general spirit of 'design-to-code' but none of the evidence mentions importing an actual Figma file or external design file, only Replit's own design templates. missing for 10: explicit Figma file import/upload support, third-party design-file ingestion, and any independent/hands-on confirmation that external design files can be implemented as-is.
